settings.title: Provider settings
settings.description: Add a supported provider or disable it. Use the arrows to change card order in every view. Connection settings are kept when disabled.
settings.failed: Could not load or save settings. Try again.
settings.connect.claude: Uses your Claude Code login. Sign in with claude first.
settings.connect.codex: Uses your Codex login. Sign in with codex first.
settings.connect.opencode-go: Uses OpenCode authentication or the OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY secret in Bitwarden.
settings.connect.zai: Uses OpenCode authentication or the ZAI_API_KEY secret in Bitwarden.
settings.connect.deepseek: Uses OpenCode authentication or the DEEPSEEK_API_KEY secret in Bitwarden.
settings.secretHelp: Enter the secret name, e.g. OPENROUTER_API_KEY. Store the API key itself in Bitwarden Secrets Manager. Existing OpenCode authentication or environment keys are also used.
settings.connect.openrouter: API key budget. Uses OPENROUTER_API_KEY or OpenCode authentication. An unlimited key has no quota percentage.
settings.connect.kimi-code: Kimi Code subscription quotas. Requires a Code key (KIMI_CODE_API_KEY), separate from Moonshot API.
settings.connect.moonshot: Kimi / Moonshot API balance. Requires MOONSHOT_API_KEY. Code subscription keys do not work here.
settings.connect.minimax: Token Plan quotas. Requires a subscription key (MINIMAX_API_KEY), separate from the pay-as-you-go API key.
settings.connect.openai-api: Local OpenCode / pi API usage only. Separate from ChatGPT / Codex subscription quotas. No remote quota check.
settings.connect.gemini: Local Google API usage from OpenCode / pi. Gemini CLI subscriptions are excluded. No remote quota check.
